claim: A boot check's expected ROM view must include the register block the stub writes, and a deliberately broken stub (no 1FFD write, no unlock, hooks not copied) must fail the check.

evidence.text: Maintainers' note: the check first showed 17 'ROM differs' bytes in that block.

The expected ROM view must include the register block the stub writes at boot (it first showed 17 "ROM differs" bytes there); a deliberately broken stub (no 1FFD write, no unlock, hooks not copied) must fail the boot check.
